source.title: Experimental analysis of the efficacy of vegetable oil-based nanolubricants for improving journal-bearing performance
source.authors: Anil Dhanola and Hem Chander Garg

interpretation.note: BDL2 denotes the paper's reported 0.02 vol% TiO2 mixture. The solver uses its measured viscosity and density directly; it does not derive mixture properties from concentration.
interpretation.preparation: The paper reports a 1:3 TiO2-to-Triton X-100 mass ratio. Particle and surfactant transport are not modelled separately.

model_scope: isothermal properties fixed at their tabulated 40 C values
mass-conserving Reynolds-JFO film rupture and reformation
properties transplanted into the conical reference case; the paper's cylindrical rig geometry, 0.1 MPa supply, load-controlled eccentricity, and thermal field are not reproduced
no particle transport, energy equation, or thermal-conductivity model
